title: euphorbia graeca subsp. dalmatica
intro: Euphorbia graeca subsp. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian spurge, is a species of spurge native to the Dinaric Alps region of the Balkan Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Euphorbia graeca subsp. dalmatica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help in wound healing and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and cardenolides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protective effects.
